releases.name: v0.1.0 — MVP: verified smart compaction for OpenCode V2
releases.body:
First public release: the MVP port of [pi-smart-compact](https://github.com/alpertarhan/pi-smart-compact)'s ESV pipeline (Extract → Synthesize → Verify) to the OpenCode V2 `compaction` hook.

## Install

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": ["opencode-smart-compact"]
}
```

Published on npm: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-smart-compact>

## What's in

- **Prune → Extract → Synthesize → Verify → yield gate** pipeline that replaces OpenCode's compaction summary only when it proves a real token win
- **Fail-closed**: small transcripts, verification or yield rejection, timeouts, and any error leave `event.result` unset, so native compaction runs unchanged
- **Cheaper synthesis**: point `summaryModel` at a cheap model — the verify gate keeps quality honest regardless of who wrote the draft
- **Deterministic fallback**: malformed LLM output falls back to a verified skeleton instead of aborting
- Config via plugin options or `OPENCODE_SMART_COMPACT_*` env vars

## Known limitations

- Multi-pass Explore, `smart_recall` / `smart_save_memory` tools, and the TUI status layer are not ported yet


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alpertarhan/opencode-smart-compact/commits/v0.1.0
